test_title: PYST 16: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 24th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'FLOAT' is written as 'ROU', 'CLAIM' is written as 'OAV'. How will 'ARMED' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :

Sum of First two letters → First letter of new word

Third letter → Second letter of new word

Sum of last two letters → Third letter of new word

'FLOAT' is written as 'ROU'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/315d1605cb42a538e40acaa469800f9a1bc55f47e6c8e366ca84fbd778372e39.png] 

And

'CLAIM' is written as 'OAV'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7d70506c79f8536422ca6f2471c5f1254287459d04b74af25603c8489e15dda7.png] 

Similarly,

'ARMED' will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/71febf285f874d18c001f0401c8af34869f6e7e34ac90ef8e9380692b7c685b2.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"SMI".**
